verdict.rationale: A state business-registry and e-filing service could plausibly offer a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only browser-based online filing, print-and-mail forms, and HTML5 browser support, with no API endpoints, API documentation, or developer access. The robots.txt probe does not address API availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
